subpageUsage: Same Results component as the homepage, configured by props (no explicit `variant` prop). On every subpage the testimonial block is switched off (testimonial={null}); the centred H2 may carry an italic emphasis phrase and is followed by a grey centred subtitle (with at most one inline link); cards drop the homepage's required logo + brand pairing: each card may show a top-left text label (/lms/professional-services, /lms/demo-platform), a neutral logo placeholder, or both, then the big stat and an optional grey line led by an optional underlined brand link; the centred CTA button is optional. Grid columns are per page: 4 / 2 / 1 (default), 3 square cards that overflow-scroll on phones (/lms/professional-services), or 5 auto columns (/lms/demo-platform). Used on /lms, /lms/small-business, /lms/corporate-lms, /lms/enterprise, /lms/professional-services and /lms/demo-platform.
evidenceNotes: Checked: testimonial={null} on all six subpage usages (Lms.jsx, SmallBusiness.jsx, CorporateLms.jsx, Enterprise.jsx, ProfessionalServices.jsx, DemoPlatform.jsx). Only the homepage renders the testimonial.

On subpages the card's top-left slot is passed through the `label` prop as JSX: a bare <LogoPlaceholder/> (/lms, /lms/small-business, /lms/corporate-lms, /lms/enterprise), a green tag + LogoPlaceholder (/lms/demo-platform) or a text string (/lms/professional-services). The contract splits this into label (text) and logo (media).
/lms renders a local FinalQuote block (centred quote + author + demo button) right after Results inside the same wrapper; it is page JSX, not part of Results.

pages-manifest.json maps results->Results on /case-studies/lms, /company (twice) and /whats-included, but none of those page files render Results: /company uses src/pages/company/StatsResults.jsx + ProofResults.jsx, /whats-included uses ProofResults.jsx, and /case-studies/lms has a page-local results grid in CaseStudiesLms.jsx.
Longest real instances: subtitle 31 words (/lms/professional-services), rest 22 words (/lms/small-business card 4), CTA 9 words (/lms/corporate-lms).
